## Problem and resulting behavior

What changed and why? Link the issue/discussion and relevant scenario or experiment when applicable.

Change kind: implementation / scenario / metric / methodology / experiment / interpretation / documentation. Keep only the relevant kinds.

## Validation

State what was actually tested and the outcomes: format, Clippy, tests, release build and relevant scenario/replay checks. Explain omitted checks briefly; a small documentation change needs no new tests.

## Research impact

Do existing results change? State whether assumptions, workload definitions, metrics, event schema, methodology, interpretation or reproducibility change. For an unaffected change, one sentence is enough.

For research-affecting changes: distinguish implementation correctness from evidence for the hypothesis. Link the before-outcome protocol/independent workload rationale and complete comparisons, including losses and controls. Explain artifact provenance and comparability; never select or retune workloads solely to improve temporal-policy outcomes.

## Review loop

- [ ] Local validation completed
- [ ] CI completed successfully
- [ ] CodeRabbit review completed for the current head
- [ ] Valid automated and human findings addressed or explicitly resolved
- [ ] Incremental review completed after the final code push (or initial review covers it)
- [ ] Research freeze/provenance impact checked
